source_text: Putei rursus. Foedus cum Abimelech. Haec Homiliae XI finis de mansione Isaac. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Wells again. Covenant with Abimelech. These of-Homily XI end about sojourn of-Isaac. Amen.
pass_b_english: Wells again. [[Covenant with Abimelech >> Bible:Genesis 26:26-31]]. This is Homily XI’s end on Isaac’s sojourn. Amen.
